1Executive Overview & Core Architecture

The VANRITI WhatsApp CMS & Commerce Suite is an enterprise-grade customer engagement and conversational commerce engine natively embedded within the VANRITI Laravel platform. It integrates directly with Meta Cloud API (v21.0), facilitating high-speed bi-directional messaging, rich multimedia broadcasts, automated order fulfillment notifications, and instant customer service.

The 24-Hour Customer Care Window Principle WhatsApp enforces a strict privacy and anti-spam rule:
  • Within 24 Hours: When a customer sends an inbound message to VANRITI, a 24-hour service session opens. Staff and bots may exchange unlimited free-form text, photos, invoices, and audio with zero per-message Meta template fees.
  • Outside 24 Hours: Once the 24-hour timer expires, free-form messaging is locked. Outbound messages must use pre-approved Meta templates (Utility, Marketing, or Authentication). Sending an approved template that the user replies to immediately re-opens a brand new 24-hour window.

Key Inbox Features & Tooling

Feature Functionality Operational Benefit
Dual Polling Engine Polls active chat every 3s and conversation directory every 5s silently via JSON endpoints. Real-time message updates without ever requiring manual page refreshes.
24h Session Tracker Visual green/red banner calculating exact hours and minutes remaining in customer window. Prevents accidental failed sends by alerting agent when template is required.
Media Dispatcher Direct upload for product photos (.jpg, .png), PDF catalogs, audio notes, and MP4 videos. Enhances customer assistance with visual proofs, lookbooks, and receipts.
Quick-Reply Shortcuts Type / into input box to trigger predefined responses (e.g., /hours, /return). Reduces agent response latency by over 80%.
Staff Internal Notes Yellow sticky-style notes stored in chat history, visible only to team members. Seamless handoffs between different support shifts.

Step-by-Step Campaign Workflow

  1. 1
    Select Meta-Approved Template
    Choose from synchronized templates. The form dynamically reads template parameters (e.g. {{1}}, {{2}}) and renders corresponding input fields.
  2. 2
    Segment Target Audience
    Filter recipients: All Registered Customers, VIP High-Spenders, Abandoned Cart Users, or paste a Custom CSV phone list.
  3. 3
    Pre-Flight Test Send
    Enter a test mobile number and click Send Test. The system verifies formatting on your device before public dispatch.
  4. 4
    Immediate & Queue-Resilient Dispatch
    Campaign executes immediately via ProcessWhatsAppCampaignJob::dispatchSync() with asynchronous queue fallback, ensuring zero messages get stuck in pending queues.
4Chatbot Automation & Smart Rules (/admin/whatsapp/bot)

The WhatsApp Bot engine handles customer service routing, instant order tracking, and FAQ self-service around the clock.

Strict Admin Opt-In Gating (Default: Disabled) To ensure zero unsolicited messages are sent to your customers:
  • Welcome Messages on Register: Controlled by whatsapp_auto_welcome_enabled (Default: 0 / OFF).
  • Bot Automated Replies: Controlled by whatsapp_bot_auto_reply_enabled (Default: 0 / OFF).
  • Away Messages: Controlled by whatsapp_away_message_enabled (Default: 0 / OFF).
Automated replies will never fire unless explicitly enabled by an administrator in Admin Settings → WhatsApp Meta API.

5Meta Templates & Cloud Sync (/admin/whatsapp/templates)

Meta requires all proactive, outbound messages initiated by businesses outside the 24-hour customer window to follow pre-approved message templates. The Templates dashboard integrates directly with the Meta Graph API.

Template Categories & Permitted Uses

Category Description & Use Cases Meta Pricing Tier Approval Time
UTILITY Order confirmations, shipping updates, account receipts, payment reminders. Lowest Cost Instant to 15 mins (Automated AI review)
MARKETING Promotional discounts, product announcements, festive greetings, abandoned cart offers. Standard Marketing Rate 15 mins to 2 hours
AUTHENTICATION One-Time Passwords (OTP) with zero-tap copy buttons. Fixed Auth Rate Near Instant
Template Creation Rulebook When creating a new template via Admin → WhatsApp → Templates → New Template:
  • Header: Optional. Can be Text (e.g., Order Confirmed!) or Media (Image / Document).
  • Body Parameters: Use consecutive integers enclosed in curly braces: Hi {{1}}, your order {{2}} has shipped!.
  • Buttons: Up to 3 Quick Reply buttons or 2 Call-to-Action buttons (URL with dynamic redirect or Phone number).
  • Forbidden: Never include misleading claims or excessive emoji strings; Meta will reject them immediately.

Monitoring your Meta Business Account health is crucial to avoid sending restrictions and number blocks.

Health Metric Current Thresholds Action Required if Degraded
Quality Rating GREEN (High)
YELLOW (Medium)
RED (Low) 		If rating drops to Red, reduce broadcast volume immediately and review campaign unsubscribes to prevent phone number bans.
Messaging Limit Tier • Tier 1: 1,000 unique recipients / 24h
• Tier 2: 10,000 unique recipients / 24h
• Tier 3: 100,000 unique recipients / 24h
• Tier 4: Unlimited recipients 		Meta automatically upgrades your tier when you send at least 50% of your daily limit with a Green quality rating.
Sync Profile Direct bi-directional push/pull of Business Name, About, Logo, Email, and Website. Ensures Meta profile matches current boutique branding at all times.
7Admin Configuration Master Reference

Navigate to Admin Panel → Settings → WhatsApp Meta API to manage all 20 integration keys:

Configuration Key Type Default Description & Operational Usage
whatsapp_phone_number_id Text - Meta Phone Number ID from WhatsApp App Dashboard.
whatsapp_waba_id Text - WhatsApp Business Account ID for template syncing.
whatsapp_access_token Password - Encrypted System User Permanent Token with whatsapp_business_messaging scope.
whatsapp_auto_welcome_enabled Boolean 0 (OFF) Sends welcome WhatsApp template when a new customer registers on the store.
whatsapp_bot_auto_reply_enabled Boolean 0 (OFF) Enables bot to intercept greetings and tracking queries automatically.
whatsapp_away_message_enabled Boolean 0 (OFF) Sends automated out-of-hours notice to customers contacting after hours.
whatsapp_away_message_text Textarea Default text Custom message sent when away messages are enabled.
whatsapp_otp_enabled Boolean 1 (ON) Enables WhatsApp OTP for customer login and password resets.
whatsapp_orders_enabled Boolean 1 (ON) Sends instant order confirmation templates on successful checkout.
whatsapp_shipping_notifications_enabled Boolean 1 (ON) Sends automated WhatsApp tracking alerts when orders ship via ShipMojo.
whatsapp_recovery_enabled Boolean 1 (ON) Automated abandoned cart recovery message with instant checkout links.
whatsapp_recovery_delay_hours Number 2 Hours to wait after cart abandonment before sending recovery alert.
whatsapp_welcome_template_name Text welcome_customer Meta template slug used for new customer registration greetings.
whatsapp_order_template_name Text order_confirmation Meta template slug for order confirmation notifications.
whatsapp_dispatch_template_name Text order_dispatched Meta template slug for shipment dispatch notifications.
Summary of Safeguards Implemented All automated messaging triggers now respect strict administrator controls:
  1. No customer will receive automated greetings unless whatsapp_auto_welcome_enabled is toggled ON.
  2. No bot menus or automated answers will be dispatched unless whatsapp_bot_auto_reply_enabled is toggled ON.
  3. Broadcast campaigns dispatch immediately without getting stuck in background queues.
  4. All template previews on the campaign creator render dynamically with live variable interpolation.
